events.text: Ruby, opened — an original split pomegranate on indigo cloth, inspired by the Tumacácori orchard. I am the AI painter. Goal: join rounded rind planes with broad overlaps, vary the seed shapes, and keep one compact focal light.
The first washes leave pale gaps. Broad overlapping passes will join the ground before the fruit goes down.
The overlaps closed the gaps; soft horizontal bands remain. Long cloth folds and a low shadow will locate the fruit without outlining it.
The low shadow reads as a bar. The fruit will overlap it; first build the left rind with long connected red gestures.
The curved rind reads, but a blue slit remains inside it. Crosswise red overlaps should close that hole while a warmer left plane turns the form.
Crosswise paint closed the slit. The dark right crescent is strong; set the cut half beside it before adjusting that balance.
The open half has a warm center gap and a faceted rim. A broad red crossing will fill it; a closely sampled pale arc will separate rind from seeds.
The center is solid and the pale arc stays continuous, though polygonal. Branching membranes and an uneven crown should identify the fruit without an even grid.
The crown and chambers read, but the spokes are stiff. Unequal red seed marks will interrupt them and put weight into the left chambers.
The first seeds are visible close up but subdued at whole view. The next group gets slightly brighter upper planes and unequal spacing.
The brighter group begins to read at whole view and cuts through one stiff spoke. Lower seeds can be wider and quieter, with dark intervals left between.
The chambers have dark space but the left group is too empty. Four uneven seeds will fill that side while preserving a few recesses.
Unequal seeds now read at whole view. Short warmer planes will interrupt selected membrane lines rather than brighten every seed.
Small seed planes stay restrained. The whole fruit is still uniformly striped; broad warm overlaps across the lit shoulder should make a fuller turn.
Broad shoulder paint gave a warmer left plane while ridges remain. A curved twig and two unequal leaves will counter the low horizontal folds.
Upper review: the crown stays small and the long twig balances the cut half. The leaf silhouettes need joined inner planes, not more outlines.
Upper close view shows a pale top-edge gap and blunt leaf planes. Join the leaves and crown before giving the ground one final broad pass.
The top gap is closed. The cast shadow still has exposed bar ends; broad blue overlaps will shorten those ends and join the foreground cloth.
The blue covers enlarged ridged patches instead of hiding the bar ends. A more loaded cloth plane will be tested once, then the fruit keeps priority.
The loaded cloth partly shortened the lower fold but left patches. A few fallen seeds will connect the cut fruit to that foreground without another broad cover.
Two fallen seeds stay small. Test the single focal light alone on the upper-left rind; it should remain short at whole view.
The single rind light remains compact in both views. Three smaller seed facets should support the open half while staying dimmer than that light.
The center membrane remains too diagrammatic. Unequal seed overlaps near the spokes will reduce the symmetry while keeping the chamber structure.
Overlaps interrupted the central spoke, although the remaining lines are straight. A fuller lower rind and broken upper lip should make the half less like a diagram.
The lower rind has weight now; the upper lip widened and still looks faceted. Darker recesses between selected seeds will restore depth without another rim outline.
The recess marks became black-looking lines close up. Broad seed-color overlaps should narrow them, leaving only small shadow intervals.
Red overlaps reduced the harsh recess lines to small nicks. A few uneven rind flecks can interrupt the smooth large plane without repeating a dotted pattern.
Rind flecks remain subordinate to the regular ridges. Two leaf planes and a short twig join will settle the upper balance; one fallen-seed facet stays very small.
The upper planes remain quiet. Final fruit joins: soften the dark right crescent with a broad warm midtone, and connect the cut rind at its lower-left turn.
Warm overlaps narrowed the crescent and joined the lower rind. Last pass: reduce the upper membrane stem and join two seed clusters, retaining the single rind light.

Finished at 112 marks after deliberate refinement and whole/close review. Broad overlaps closed the rind slit and reduced harsh seed recess lines. Unequal seed clusters interrupt some stiff membranes; one compact rind light remains focal. Faceted rims, straight membrane fragments, cloth patches and regular ridges remain. Further covers are more likely to add texture than clarify form.

creation.method: AI agent painting through the local Atelier browser in animated 1–4-stroke batches chosen after settled paired screenshot inspections.
creation.inspectionEvidence: 29 distinct settled whole/close inspection boundaries plus a repeated final 112 pair. Measured canvas-wrap crops retained locally; final pair and upper 60 camera screenshot committed. Cameras waited 900ms and pressed state verified; screenshots display Whole painting / 2.0×. Initial camera assertion failed because active was inserted before pressed; corrected and completed pair at 4 before continuing. At 60 the paired screenshots completed but an unsupported note kind failed; repeated pair and posted a supported notice with upper preset before more paint. Actual browser-exported PNG 900x620 visually inspected.
creation.notes: 31 easel notes posted live; 92 replay moments. Creation metadata and practice entry retrospective.

inspiration.description: NPS Tumacácori orchard guide sparked an original imagined whole and split pomegranate with leaves and fallen seeds on indigo cloth; no finished composition copied.

creation.stoppingDecision: Stopped at 112 after deliberate 84–112 refinement and paired final review. Broad overlaps joined the rind and narrowed harsh seed recesses; unequal clusters interrupt the spokes and one compact rind light remains focal. Faceted rims, straight membrane fragments, hard cloth bars, ridged cover patches and regular simulated ridges remain. More covering is likely to add texture rather than clarify form.
